result.summary: The page layout is largely intact: the header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, carousel, and bottom navigation all render cleanly. The only issues found are minor content and styling concerns. The clipped chips and carousel items at the right edge and the partially visible card at the bottom are expected scroll behavior and were not counted.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards with the same image, title, and delivery fee, which looks like duplicated or placeholder data.
issues.suggestion: Verify the data source and show distinct restaurants, or deduplicate the list before rendering.

issues.description: The delivery-time pills ('15–25 min') sit directly over the bottom of the poké bowl images and partially cover the food.
issues.suggestion: Move the time badge to a corner or a consistent position outside the image area so the product photo is not obscured.
